title: The media forgot about Panama — Trump didn't. Now we're evicting China
text:
National newsrooms have developed a dangerous blind spot at our own doorstep: the Panama Canal. While the legacy media remain utterly consumed by a predictable loop of domestic political theater and European updates, a major foreign policy shift is actively reshaping the Western Hemisphere, completely unremarked. Within its first six months in office, the Trump administration signaled a sharp reversal of previous diplomatic passivity in the region.

Operating under a modernized interpretation of the Monroe Doctrine, Washington has quietly engaged in intense legal, economic, and military maneuvering to secure the waterway and systematically exclude Chinese influence. Despite a glaring media blackout, these actions are fundamentally upending regional security today. The canal has transformed into a primary, active theater of great power competition. This is not a legacy review of 20th-century gunboat diplomacy. It is a live, sophisticated masterclass in infrastructure denial and supply chain security that the press have entirely failed to cover.
